title.zh: 新加坡共和国宪法（高级外交官员）命令
title.en: Constitution of the Republic of Singapore (Senior Diplomatic Officers) Order

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Constitution of the Republic of Singapore (Senior Diplomatic Officers) Order.

heading.en: Consuls-General and Consuls not considered as holding public office

text.en:
2. For the purposes of the Constitution, no person shall be considered as holding a public office or an office of profit by reason of the fact that he is in receipt of any remuneration or allowances (including a pension or other like allowance) in respect of his tenure of office as Consul-General or Consul.
[G.N. No. S 212/72]
